stories.title: The expansion no one asked for: CFP's 24-team move has problems
stories.summary: The CFP is nearing a deal to make the tournament bigger. Bigger isn't better, and this one could really miss.

stories.title: ESPN secures 'handshake agreement' to broadcast 24-team CFP, sources say
stories.summary: The "handshake agreement" is a step toward a 24-team playoff beginning in the 2027 season.

stories.title: Packers RB Jacobs eligible to return next week amid ongoing probe
stories.summary: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

stories.title: Broncos' Cooper removed from exempt list, could still face league discipline
stories.summary: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was removed from the commissioner exempt list Friday, meaning he's available to play in Week 7. Cooper, who was arrested twice in a seven-day span in June on domestic violence charges, has been on the list since Aug. 30.

stories.title: Titans CEO apologizes to fans, believes Saleh, GM can turn it around
stories.summary: Titans CEO Burke Nihill said the organization believes that coach Robert Saleh and GM Mike Borgonzi are "ultimately going to get this team out of the woods."
